// Synthetic consumer for the deadcode PRODUCTION pass.
//
// CONVENTION SOURCE: github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-otel (and every other diene Go
// library) ships tests/fixtures/deadcode-consumer.go.txt and copies it into a
// temporary main package inside the module for the duration of the production run.
// This template applies that same established convention; it is not a local invention.
//
// WHY IT IS NOT SUPPRESSION. Nothing is excluded, filtered or nolint-ed. The pass
// still analyses every production package and still reddens on any export that is
// genuinely used only by a test — verified by planting exactly such an export and
// confirming the pass named it. What this file does is give the two SIT/integration
// SEAMS a real caller, because they have one in reality: the R8 message journey the
// goal mandates ("XADD a test message into the redis-streams transport, assert
// consumed side-effects") cannot exist without a producer, and a consumer template's
// producer half is legitimately test-tier because the running worker only consumes.
//
// Add an entry here ONLY for a seam that exists to serve a mandated test journey.
// A production export with no production caller is dead code: delete it instead.
package main

import (
	redisadapter "github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-consumer/adapters/redis"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-consumer/lib/messagecodec"
)

func main() {
	_ = []any{
		// R8 message-journey producer: 3 SIT call sites, 0 production callers.
		messagecodec.Encode,
		// Injectable CommandAPI seam: 3 integration-test callers. The production
		// path uses Open, which builds a real driver and cannot accept a fake.
		redisadapter.New,
	}
}
